With a sincerity typical of his informal personality, a tribute from Mr. Sam McKee, now of Ralls, Texas, in a letter of his former pupils, gives the following vivid picture of the personality of Mr. Halsell as his ex-students remember him:

I wish it were in my power to recall and record all of the incidents and happenings that took place in our school days at Savoy College. But if not written or recorded items, the intervening span of years in school that has been gathered in Texas where the old days are always remembered. 'It was my joy to be closely associated with College men and women. He drew the 'Fireside Chats' that he used to make to the student body upon occasions in which of his deep reverence, to apply ourselves in order that we might fit ourselves to be useful men and women.
